name: CP4AIOpsKafkaFrequentISRShrinks
description:
Warning alert for Replicas fall out of sync with the leader -  InSync Replica (ISR) Shrinks value >0
Kafka manages an In-Sync Replica set to ensure data durability and high availability. When a follower replica stops keeping pace with the leader—probably due to broker resource exhaustion, network issue—Kafka removes it from the ISR list, causing a "shrink" event
